label: The Stolen Manual
summary: Someone stole your sect's secret technique manual on the night of the tournament. Your master gives you seven days to bring it back.
title: The Stolen Manual
description: On the night before the Nine Rivers tournament, the Willow Sect's Manual of the Falling Leaf was stolen from the sealed library. If it is used against the sect at the tournament, three hundred years of honor end. Your master gives you seven days and one instruction: bring it back without starting a war.

chapterOutlines.title: The Empty Shelf
chapterOutlines.outline: Investigate the theft in the Willow Sect's library.

chapterOutlines.title: The River Road
chapterOutlines.outline: Follow the thief through teahouses, river towns and ambushes.

chapterOutlines.title: The Tournament
chapterOutlines.outline: Fight in the tournament, where the stolen technique will be used.

chapterOutlines.title: The Truth of the Manual
chapterOutlines.outline: Learn why it was stolen, and what it really contains.

scene.location: The Willow Sect's library on Mount Qingliu, at dawn, the morning after the theft
scene.summary: The seal on the door is unbroken. The shelf is empty. Your master is kneeling before it, very still.

openThreads: Which sect wants the Falling Leaf, and why?

npcs.name: Master Wu Lan
npcs.description: Your master, small, white-haired and the most dangerous person on the mountain. She speaks only when she has to.
goals: Keep the peace between the sects

npcs.name: Bai Jian
npcs.description: Your senior brother in the sect, perfect in every form, who has been strangely quiet since the theft.
goals: Become the next head of the sect

npcs.name: Fei Mei
npcs.description: A wandering swordswoman with no sect, a fondness for wine and a habit of turning up wherever trouble is.
goals: Settle an old grudge against the Iron Gate Sect

items.name: Willow sword
items.description: A plain, perfectly balanced sword given to every disciple of the sect.

items.name: Healing pills
items.description: Bitter herbal pills that close wounds and restore qi.

items.name: Master Wu's token
items.description: A jade token that tells any ally of the Willow Sect you speak for the master.
